title: Beauty and the Beast
author: Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont

authorInfo.bio: Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont (1711–1780) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Beauty and the Beast" by Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont is a fairy tale published in 1756. When a merchant plucks a rose from an enchanted castle, he faces death at the hands of a hideous Beast—unless one of his daughters takes his place.
